subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue stay open as the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata coordination item while final fallback semantics are owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI UX, Gateway protocol shape, runtime prompt context, and durable delivery semantics, and open PRs/issues already own major slices; automation could choose the wrong permanent boundary.

options.title: Keep Open And Split Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata contract and explicitly route final fallback delivery semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Use The Runtime PR For Metadata
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 as the candidate reply-metadata implementation after conflicts and sibling-surface review, with any Control UI-specific gap tracked here or in a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Close After Canonical Split
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers choose one canonical reply metadata item and one canonical no-output delivery item that preserve the Control UI context.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Split Scope
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata contract and explicitly route final fallback delivery semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz owns the open maintainer-labeled durable final fallback contract that must be sequenced with the Control UI reply metadata work.
